description: Chain of four distortions in stereo, each with its own attenuverter and CV input: wavefolding, bit crushing, asymmetric clipping and hard clipping

params.text: Folds the signal back on itself within a threshold, which adds harmonics
Reduces the number of bits used to represent the signal, for a low-fi digital sound
Attenuates and inverts the FOLD input before it is added to the FOLD knob
Attenuates and inverts the CRUSH input before it is added to the CRUSH knob
Attenuates and inverts the DISTORT input before it is added to the DISTORT knob
Attenuates and inverts the SATURATE input before it is added to the SATURATE knob

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio to be distorted
A control voltage added to the FOLD setting, scaled by the FOLD attenuverter
A control voltage added to the CRUSH setting, scaled by the CRUSH attenuverter
A control voltage added to the DISTORT setting, scaled by the DISTORT attenuverter
A control voltage added to the SATURATE setting, scaled by the SATURATE attenuverter
The right channel of the audio to be distorted

outputs.text: The left channel of the distorted signal
The right channel of the distorted signal
